## Don't file this issue

For security-relevant bugs (privacy / scrub regressions, memory safety,
supply-chain, information disclosure in normal output), use **GitHub's
private vulnerability reporting** instead:

https://github.com/adamson34/otsniff/security/advisories/new

See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for what counts as in-scope.

If your issue is *not* security-relevant (false positives in findings,
feature requests, etc.), close this issue and use the bug or feature
template instead.
